title: Batching Efficiency Orchestrator — workload-profiled heuristics & safe apply
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Teams running long-tail LLM workloads see large variance in per-token cost due to suboptimal batching and cache configuration. We need an orchestrator that automatically recommends and safely applies continuous batching parameters (batch size windows, KV alignment, microburst backoff) derived from per-customer workload profiles and heuristics — while ensuring no regression in latency or model output quality.

Goal: Build a Batching Efficiency Orchestrator (BEO) that: (1) ingests live telemetry and offline profiles, (2) synthesizes workload signatures, (3) generates conservative heuristic parameter suggestions, (4) performs shadow/ canary applies (shadow-apply) to estimate cost/latency impact, and (5) executes rollback or gradual rollout when thresholds are exceeded. The emphasis is on safe automated applies with clear human-in-the-loop checkpoints for customers with high risk profiles.

Scope: This ticket covers the engine core (profiling + suggestion generator), shadow-apply runner, integration with rollout service (canary/gradual percentage), rollback triggers, and observability surfaces (Grafana dashboards + alerting). It does NOT include UI for user-editable rules (follow-up PM ticket).
acceptance_criteria: BEO can consume per-customer request traces and produce a stable workload signature within 10 minutes of collection for a typical 100k-request sample
Suggestion engine outputs parameter sets (batch_target, batch_window_ms, kv_alignment_threshold, microburst_backoff_ms) with an estimated cost delta and confidence score

Shadow-apply runner simulates suggested params against live traffic for a configurable percentile and reports latency impact (P50/P95) and downstream cost estimate without affecting production responses
Rollout controller can perform staged percentage rollouts (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) and auto-rollback if latency P95 increases by >10% or error rate increases by >0.5% relative to baseline
End-to-end tests and a canary on staging demonstrate no QoS regressions for 48-hour smoke run with mixed short/long prompt distributions
Telemetry dashboards (#grafana-batching-behavior) show before/after cost per 1M tokens, average tokens/sec, and KV cache hit rate for customers in control vs candidate cohorts
tasks: Design workload signature proto and storage fields (sequence length distribution, inter-arrival distribution, prefix reuse rate)
Implement ingestion pipeline: sample traces -> feature extractor -> signature writer
Build suggestion engine: heuristic rule-set + lightweight ML scorer to rank parameter sets
Create shadow-apply runner that mirrors requests into a sandboxed inference path and measures token/time/cost metrics
Integrate with rollout service to sequence staged applies and feed back metrics for decisioning
Define rollback triggers and implement automatic rollback path in rollout controller
Add Grafana dashboards and alerting rules; link to cost/reporting dashboard
Write e2e tests, load tests, and privacy review (PII handling) documentation
Prepare security review package and run threat model with Security team
Draft runbook for on-call and customer-facing incident communications

notes: Risk: Incorrect heuristics could increase latency for tail-sensitive customers. Mitigation: shadow-apply + conservative confidence threshold + human approval for high-risk customers.
Telemetry: retain 90 days of signature history for trend analysis and regression detection; tag signatures by schema version to support rolling algorithm upgrades.
Performance consideration: signature extraction must be O(n) over sampled traces and run in a bounded window to avoid CPU spikes on ingestion hosts.
Customer opt-out: provide opt-out flag at customer config level; ensure opt-out propagates to suggestion pipeline and rollout controller
